pdfs.title: A six-dimensional unit-step walk with no collinear triple
pdfs.attribution: Named draft author: Erik Kalviainen. Alternating signed-Gaussian source uses Cambie's offsets and Shallit's basis encoding on the Cambie-Kalviainen foundation.
pdfs.status: Proposed six-dimensional upper bound; independent review pending; not Lean-formalized. No global minimality claim.
